cliffhanger_details.ending_assessment: Clean cut snapping to beat boundary without lingering post-tension decompression.

full_promo_dialogue.dialogue: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.

You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.
